# TextureAtlas

[Toolkit](README.md) · `DotGame.Toolkit.Graphics` · class

```csharp
public sealed class TextureAtlas : IContent
```

Types: [`IContent`](https://github.com/hotchaipro/DotGame.Framework/blob/main/docs/api/Framework/IContent.md)

Represents a texture atlas: a single packed texture (or small set of packed textures) composed of many named rectangular regions, each of which was originally a separate source texture.
